- .claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py (and the workflow-templates twin at workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script enforces only the format of `why=` for PR-scoped stops; it never verifies that the PR number `<N>` extracted from `why=` matches the `pr` used to compute the fingerprint.
  WHY: A mis-attributed grant silently moves a budget round from the intended PR to a different one, causing incorrect cap counting.
- CLAUDE.md | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The failure-escalations bullet contains contradictory instructions: it says escalation stops send no `PushNotification` and hand off to the judge, but the trailing issue-mode text says to send one and wait for `/reclarify`.
  WHY: A session following the trailing instructions may notify and wait instead of arming the escalation wait, so the project checker never starts the judge and the escalation stalls.

  WHY: The cap rule attributes the grant to the PR in `why=`, so a mismatch can give another PR an extra intervention without its own grant.
